data.name: ChangeSchema
data.value: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS context_changes ( sequence BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, category TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT NOT NULL, version_id TEXT NOT NULL, known_at TEXT NOT NULL, known_ticks BIGINT NOT NULL, company_ids TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(category,entity_id,version_id));

data.name: AppendChange
data.value: INSERT INTO context_changes(category,entity_id,version_id,known_at,known_ticks,company_ids) VALUES(@c,@i,@v,@t,@ticks,@s)

data.name: ReadNextChange
data.value: SELECT sequence,category,entity_id,version_id,known_at,company_ids FROM context_changes WHERE sequence>@after ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1

data.name: KnowledgeSchema
FindKnowledgeHash
data.value: SELECT (SELECT hash FROM knowledge_revisions WHERE category=@c AND entity_id=@e AND revision_id=@r)

data.name: InsertKnowledge
data.value: INSERT INTO knowledge_revisions VALUES(@c,@e,@r,@t,@h,@p)

data.name: LatestKnowledge
data.value: SELECT k.payload FROM knowledge_revisions k WHERE category=@c AND known_ticks <= @t AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_revisions newer WHERE newer.category=k.category AND newer.entity_id=k.entity_id AND newer.known_ticks <= @t AND newer.known_ticks>k.known_ticks) ORDER BY entity_id

data.name: AllKnowledge
data.value: SELECT payload FROM knowledge_revisions WHERE category=@c AND known_ticks <= @t ORDER BY entity_id,known_ticks

data.name: MaterialSchema
FindMaterialIdentity
data.value: SELECT (SELECT row_to_json(q)::text FROM (SELECT source_id,kind FROM material_versions WHERE material_id=@material LIMIT 1) q)

data.name: InsertMaterial
data.value: INSERT INTO material_versions(material_id,version_id,source_id,kind,known_at_ticks, corrects_version_id,content_hash,payload_json) VALUES(@material,@version,@source,@kind,@known,@corrects,@hash,@json)

data.name: InsertMaterialCompany
data.value: INSERT INTO material_companies(material_id,version_id,company_id) VALUES(@material,@version,@company)

data.name: ContextMaterials
data.value: SELECT m.payload_json FROM material_versions m WHERE m.known_at_ticks <= @asof AND ( (m.kind='company' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_companies c WHERE c.material_id=m.material_id AND c.version_id=m.version_id AND c.company_id=@company)) OR (m.kind='market' AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_companies c WHERE c.material_id=m.material_id AND c.version_id=m.version_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_companies c WHERE c.material_id=m.material_id AND c.version_id=m.version_id AND c.company_id=@company))) OR (m.kind='news' AND m.material_id=@news AND (NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM material_companies c WHERE c.material_id=m.material_id AND c.version_id=m.version_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_companies c WHERE c.material_id=m.material_id AND c.version_id=m.version_id AND c.company_id=@company))) ) ORDER BY m.material_id,m.known_at_ticks,m.version_id

data.name: KnownMaterials
data.value: SELECT payload_json FROM material_versions WHERE known_at_ticks <= @t ORDER BY material_id,known_at_ticks,version_id

data.name: FindMaterial
data.value: SELECT (SELECT payload_json FROM material_versions WHERE material_id=@material AND version_id=@version)

data.name: ChangeWatermark
data.value: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence),0) FROM context_changes

data.name: EvidenceWatchCursor
data.value: SELECT COALESCE(MIN(sequence)-1,@observed) FROM context_changes WHERE known_ticks>@at

data.name: CompanyEvidence
data.value: SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]')::text FROM (SELECT m.material_id AS "MaterialId",m.version_id AS "VersionId",m.content_hash AS "ContentHash",m.source_id AS "SourceId",m.known_at_ticks AS "KnownTicks" FROM material_versions m WHERE m.kind='company' AND m.known_at_ticks<=@at AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM material_companies c WHERE c.material_id=m.material_id AND c.version_id=m.version_id AND c.company_id=@company) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM material_versions newer WHERE newer.material_id=m.material_id AND newer.kind='company' AND newer.known_at_ticks<= @at AND newer.known_at_ticks>m.known_at_ticks AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM material_companies nc WHERE nc.material_id=newer.material_id AND nc.version_id=newer.version_id AND nc.company_id=@company)) ORDER BY m.material_id,m.version_id LIMIT 129) q

data.name: ProjectionSchema
data.value: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS search_projection (pipeline TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(pipeline,item_id))

data.name: ProjectionMarks
data.value: SELECT item_id,content_hash FROM search_projection WHERE pipeline=@p

data.name: UpsertProjectionMark
data.value: INSERT INTO search_projection VALUES(@p,@i,@h) ON CONFLICT(pipeline,item_id) DO UPDATE SET content_hash=excluded.content_hash

data.name: WriteLock
data.value: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(319264381)

data.name: ReadLock
data.value: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(319264381)
